item.title: Earning $121K is now considered middle class in Louisiana, study says
item.description: LOUISIANA (KTAL/KMSS) - A new study from SmartAsset found that Louisiana households earning $121,972 are now considered middle class. The study ranked Louisiana 48th in the country for the highest income a household can earn and still be considered middle class. To cross the lower threshold into the middle class, Louisiana households must earn $40,657. [...]
